_note: Fins subsystem (FIN) local numbers, owner D3, design R3 (CR-A1-28, CHANGE-LOG D-26/27/28/42). Read by fusion/fins.py (ctx.local), make_fins.py and team/D3/fins_calcs.py (P:fin_detail.*); C4, C6 and E3 read some keys too: never rename a key. Shared numbers (fin station, tube x, tube OD/ID and length, half height, TE, motor height, cant, board thickness, layers, spar) come from params/params.json; tube_length_m and layers are copies for the C4/C6 readers and fins.py checks they agree. Frame: params.json#frame (metres, x aft, y right, z up).

tube_length_m.note: copy of the shared key for the C4/C6 readers; fins.py reads params.json#fins.tube.length_m and checks they agree

bond_gap_m.note: radial gap of every printed bore on a 22 mm CF tube (bore 22.3 mm); filled with 30 min epoxy

width_m.note: spanwise, centred on the fin plane; C4 sizes the tube-bore shear-out at 36 mm (CL-C4-BLOCK-MS 0.47); core cut-out (CR-D3-03 to D1)

wall_m.note: PETG wall ahead of the tube bore and behind the spar bore (C4: 6 mm outside each bore)

x_split_m.note: boundary between the flat-topped tube socket (ahead) and the airfoil-contoured spar saddle (aft); mid-web between the bores (web 12.8 mm)

fill_factor.note: 3 perimeters + 15 % gyroid on a 40 x 65 x 30 mm block; weigh the first print

le_gap_m.note: board LE to tube surface, filled by the epoxy fillet

adhesive_kgm2.note: spray adhesive between the two board layers (3M 77 class, ~15 g/m2 wet)

root_joint_g.note: per half-fin: microballoon-epoxy fillets 2 x 0.26 m + skin-tape laps 15 mm up both faces + LE fillet to the tube (same fillet legs with two layers)

top_edge.value: straight line from the station-collar top at the LE to the start of the square tip at the half height, then flat to the TE
top_edge.note: the edge strips run along the sloped part and end at the square tip; the LE-top corner is notched for the collar tongue (station_collar.tail_m)

tip_square_m.note: last 40 mm of each half-fin (x 0.280-0.320) has a flat top edge at |z| = fins.half_height_m and nothing on it but the foot shoe; the edge strips end at its forward edge

half_width_m.note: notch in the LOWER half-fin root centred on the elevon hinge line (x = c (1 - elevon chord_frac)), for D6's inter-panel link (CR-A4-04); D6 confirms the sweep

grip_m.note: collar length on the tube; the lip cap sits on the tube end and the station collar directly below (brace ear as high as possible, CR-C4-04)

cap_t_m.note: C-ring lip that bottoms on the tube end after the slip stroke

cap_lip_r_m.note: inner radius of the lip: covers the 1 mm tube wall

head_clear_m.note: cap top below the lowest motor-screw head (2.5 mm hex key)

slit_m.note: collar split on the outboard side

ear_len_m.note: beyond the collar; pinch bolt M3x16 + nyloc along x

face_ahead_m.note: motor face at the axis this far ahead of the collar front so the collar sits >= 39 mm behind the prop plane (CR-B4-04); the canted plate corners reach about 2 mm further forward, inside the motor-base shadow

plate_t_m.note: R3: the whole motor plate is canted (front and back faces parallel to the 7 deg motor face), uniform 4.5 mm under every screw head: M3x8 engages 3.5 mm at every hole and the head bears flat (C6 CL-C6-MOTOR-HEAD-RF). Replaces the R2 flat plate + canted pads (2.5 mm engagement at 7 deg)

plate_half_y_m.note: R3: screw-head edge at 8 + 2.75 = 10.75 mm, cheeks to 14 mm; 0.5 mm beyond the cheeks

plate_half_z_m.note: R3: screw-head edge at 9.5 + 2.75 = 12.25 mm + 2.75 mm edge

bolt_pattern_m.note: cross pattern, 16 mm across y, 19 mm across z; not published. The plate is printed with 2.5 mm square pilots on this pattern and DRILLED 3.4 mm square to the face to the measured pattern, motor as template (C6 CR-C6-10: no slots)

shaft_hole_d_m.note: rear shaft and circlip clearance, printed as a 10 mm square opening in the canted plate; UNVERIFIED against the motor

cheek_y_in_m.note: inner face from the fin plane; clears the screw heads (8 + 2.75 = 10.75 mm) and overlaps the collar wall

prop_stack_m.note: motor face to prop plane: can 0.025 + adapter and hub 0.014 (E1 settles)

cant_sense_UR.note: +1: the UR thrust gets a component along +t = x_hat x r_hat (right-handed about +x). Sense unchanged at 7 deg (D-27). Prints A (UR, LL) and B (UL, LR) are mirror images; if F4 needs the other sense, swap A and B, no reprint

slip_torque_nm.note: pinch-bolt setting: the collar turns on the tube at this torque (the D-23 fuse, side loads at the motor); set with a luggage scale (BUILD.md)

mu_petg_cf.note: ASA (was PETG) on matte CF, dry; key name kept for the E3/C6 readers; only used to estimate the bolt preload, the setting is measured (T-D3-SLIP)

fill_factor.note: 2-4.5 mm ASA walls print almost solid

hardware_g.note: M3x16 SHCS 1.0 + M3 nyloc 0.25 + 2 washers 0.15 per mount

pilot_m.note: square printed pilot at each motor-screw hole, drilled out to screw_hole_d_m

material.note: HDT 93 degC; motor base 66.4 degC steady hover (CL-E3-MOUNT-ASA); PETG fails by 8 K

x0_m.note: aft of the clip tails; ESC long axis along x (hover slipstream direction)

z_m.note: |z| of the pad centre: 72 mm from the motor axis, inside the contracted slipstream and below the edge strip

slot_m.note: two strap slots (x by z) for a 10 mm hook-and-loop strap, cut through the board as well

slot_edge_m.note: strap slot edge to pad edge

material.note: ESC pad 61.6 degC (CL-E3-ESC-PEAK) against PETG 58 degC

cf_gcc.note: same basis as the spar's 0.102 kg/m

bond_g_per_joint.note: 30 min epoxy per clip or pad joint

block_bond_g.note: per block: tube bore + spar bore + core faces

fin_detail._note: Design R3 (D3): two-layer braced fin (D-26): two 4.8 mm boards laminated, CF 10 x 3 brace from a 16 mm station collar to the spar, CF 10 x 1 edge strips pinned with 2 mm CF pins every 15 mm and anchored 40 mm in a two-face collar tail (C6), internal tube plug at the block, square 40 mm tips for the feet, a strap eye on each block boss, ASA mounts (7 deg canted plate) and ESC pads (D-42).

layers.note: copy of the shared key for the C4/C6 readers (two 4.8 mm boards laminated, CL-C4-D3-SEP 0.41); one layer (CR-D3-02) rejected; fins.py reads params.json#fins.layers and checks they agree

od_m.note: CF 20 x 18 offcut sanded to slide in the 20 mm bore: internal doubler over the full 47 mm bore (C4: internal plug at every bore)

overhang_m.note: beyond the ends of the bore bosses

height_m.note: R3: 16 mm (was 12) covers C4 torsion 9.3 N m (CL-C6-COLLAR-L-REQ 13.2 mm). Top 0.5 mm below the mount collar, grows downward; the brace ear keeps its R2 height (ear_h_m) so the brace end stays at |z| 0.1535 as C4 modelled

slot_wall_m.note: R3: tail outer walls 3 perimeters (bond face for the strip outer face only)

tail_m.note: R3: two-face tail 40 mm aft of the tube surface (>= 33.7 mm, CL-C6-STRIP-EMBED-REQ): a solid tongue of board thickness fills the notched LE-top corner of the board, the strips lie in slots between the tongue and two outer walls, joined by a cap over the top edge; slots open downward

ear_len_m.note: inboard of the collar; holds the brace end in a 3.3 x 10.4 mm slot, 10 mm deep

ear_w_m.note: along x; 2.8 mm walls either side of the 10.4 mm brace slot

ear_h_m.note: brace ear height, flush with the collar top: brace end at |z| 0.1535 as accepted by C4

cap_t_m.note: cap over the strip tops joining tongue and walls (3 perimeters)

strip_slot_clear_m.note: per side, strip in its tail slot (epoxy gap)

material.note: at ambient, 30 mm below the motor plate

tongue_fill.note: tail tongue (9.6 mm thick): 3 perimeters (1.2 mm) under each strip face + 20 % gyroid core; the faces carry the bond, the tail carries ~1 350 N design tension at ~14 MPa over walls + cap + tongue perimeters (C6 re-checks, CR-D3-17); weigh the first print

tongue_depth_m.note: tongue and walls reach this far below the strip band (strip 10 mm wide + 1 mm), not the full 16 mm ring height: the board notch is only as deep as the strip

w_m.note: pultruded CF strip 10 mm wide (10 x 2, brace.t_m), 10 mm side along x (cruise flow); C4-R3 sizing sheet

t_m.note: R3: 10 x 2 mm strip, accepted by C4 on the D3 geometry (P_cr 293 N vs 166 N design, separation 0.39 with two layers; the brace stores 2-6 % of the modal strain energy, so its stiffness hardly matters); saves 9 g against 10 x 3

anchor_y_m.note: |y| of the anchor on the spar line, just outboard of D7's spar cradle and lid pillar (y 0.17-0.23, CR-D3-11): C4-R3 modelled the brace at this anchor (CL-C4-D3-BRACE-F, CL-C4-D3-SEP 0.39); lateral stiffness CL-D3-BRACE-KY is information only; clear of the elevons (x < 0.2496) and the pod

engage_m.note: strip end bonded into the ear and the anchor slots

len_x_m.note: printed saddle on the spar top, through a 20 x 16 mm pocket in the core and skin (CR-D3-03 to D1)

proud_m.note: above the skin, holds the brace slot

w_m.note: pultruded CF strip 10 x 1 mm on both faces of each half-fin along the sloped top edge, from the tube surface (inside the collar tail) to the square tip

pin_d_m.note: pultruded CF rod 2 mm, through strip-board-strip, bonded flush (CL-C6-STRIP-PIN-RF 1.41)

pin_pitch_m.note: along the strip, first pin half a pitch aft of the collar tail

height_m.note: keyhole boss on the block, above the upper skin and below the lower skin: lengthens the tube bore 27 -> 47 mm (root fixity) and holds the board root LE in its slot (replaces separate root clips)

tail_m.note: board engagement aft of the tube surface

slot_clear_m.note: per side, board in the clip slot

len_m.note: tab beyond the boss ring, outboard side (y), on every bore boss of the block: one eye per fin root (CR-H1-08)

h_m.note: above the upper skin / below the lower skin

t_m.note: along x, centred on the tube axis

hole_d_m.note: cord or 3.6 mm cable tie; hole axis along x

hole_y_m.note: hole centre outboard of the ring outer radius
